understanding.purpose: לוח זמנים המציג את היום, השעה, נושא המפגש והערות נלוות.
understanding.reading: הקורא סורק מימין לשמאל כדי למצוא יום ושעה, מזהה את הנושא וקורא את ההערות להקשר נוסף. יש לשמור על כל שורה כיחידת מידע ברורה.
groups: עמודות 1 ו־2 שייכות יחד: היום והשעה מזהים את מועד המפגש וזקוקים לרוחב קומפקטי וקבוע.
עמודות 3 ו־4 שייכות יחד: הנושא מתאר את המפגש וההערות מוסיפות פרטים, ושניהם יכולים להשתמש בשורות מרובות.
keep_intact: שמות הימים והשעות, כולל סימן הנקודתיים בשעה.
may_wrap: נושאים ארוכים יכולים להישבר בין מילים.
הערות ארוכות יכולות להישבר בין מילים; בשורה שבה גם הנושא ארוך, גובה השורה שנוצר עשוי להכיל חלק מהגלישה של שניהם.

bad.why: The topic column would receive far more space than it needs, while the longer notes would wrap repeatedly and make the rows harder to scan.

contrast.why: The topic column would receive far more space than it needs, while the longer notes would wrap repeatedly and make the rows harder to scan.

final.rationale: In r3A, the day and time columns are compact, while the notes have enough room to stay on one line. The longer topic wraps into two readable lines, keeping its row together without splitting words. The wider topic column in r3A gives that text a little more breathing room than r2B while preserving the same row heights.

general: Allocate width according to content and reading role; equal widths are rarely necessary.
Keep short identifiers intact and let longer prose wrap at natural word boundaries.
Judge line breaks and row rhythm together, not by table height alone.
specific: Day and time need only 58px and 63px here.
Giving notes at least 410px keeps both notes on one line in the rendered candidates.

final.tradeoffs: A wider topic column makes the longest topic easier to read on one line, but leaves less room for notes and introduces additional wrapping. r2B and r3A preserve single-line notes while wrapping the longest topic.
final.uncertain: The preferred ranges are conservative, based on the rendered r2B and r3A candidates; untested widths may also work equally well. Designers may reasonably prefer the more balanced column proportions of r2A or r3B despite their additional note wrapping.

A.why: Day and time are compact and the topics stay on one line, but the oversized topic column leaves substantial empty space while both notes wrap to three lines.

B.why: The compact day and time columns leave room for the longer text. The notes and longest topic wrap cleanly, though the notes make two rows taller.

C.why: Both notes fit on one line, while the longest topic wraps cleanly to two. Day and time remain compact, and the rows are easy to scan.

D.why: The column proportions support scanning, with only the first note and longest topic wrapping. The notes column is slightly too narrow to keep both notes on one line.

E.why: Day and time take up much of the width despite their short contents. The resulting narrow text columns force the notes into three lines and the longest topic into two.

F.why: Day and time are compact, and the topic column has comfortable space. Both notes wrap to two lines, making the rows taller than necessary.

reviews.unsure: C gives the notes considerably more width than the topics; that balance is appropriate for these particular entries, though it depends on their lengths.

A.why: Day and time are compact, while topic and notes have enough room to wrap cleanly. The longer entries take two lines, and the rows remain easy to scan.

B.why: The proportions are balanced and the longer topic and notes wrap cleanly. It is very similar to A, with slightly less space for notes.

C.why: The wide topic column keeps its entries on one line, but leaves substantial empty space while both notes wrap to three lines.

D.why: The wider notes column keeps the last note on one line, though the long topic wraps into two relatively short lines.

E.why: Day and time occupy disproportionately wide columns, leaving the longer topic and notes cramped. The resulting tall rows have large areas of empty space.

F.why: Compact day and time columns leave ample room for notes, both of which fit on one line. The long topic wraps cleanly to two lines, producing a clear and economical table.

reviews.unsure: A and B are very close in quality; their small width difference has little visible effect.
